title: SAFEEVALAGENT: TOWARD AGENTIC AND SELF-EVOLVING SAFETY EVALUATION OF LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Automated evaluation using the SafeEvalAgent multi-agent framework to extract rules from the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, generate multi-faceted test cases (jailbreaks, deterministic probes, multimodal queries), and iteratively refine attack strategies to test model compliance.

Agentic compliance auditing against the MAS FEAT (Monetary Authority of Singapore) Fairness principles, using a self-evolving loop where an LLM evaluator assesses model responses against structured policy rubrics and an analyst agent refines subsequent test cases.
